full_name: Ben Rivers | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Arts Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow/David and Roberta Logie Fellow Independent Filmmaker (United Kingdom)
bio: Ben Rivers is an experimental filmmaker and artist based in London. His work ranges from themes about exploring unknown wilderness territories to candid and intimate portrayals of real-life subjects.
